scope.statement: The script recorded already-visible CarlaUE4 and CAMROD Operator UI pixels. It did not command CARLA, ROS, the UI, or the vehicle.

streams.codec_long_name: H.264 / AVC / MPEG-4 AVC / MPEG-4 part 10

exact_commands: env DISPLAY=:1 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 XAUTHORITY=/run/user/1000/gdm/Xauthority ffmpeg -n -hide_banner -loglevel warning -f x11grab -draw_mouse 0 -framerate 5 -video_size 3440x1900 -i :1+140\,140 -t 1800 -an -vf pad=ceil\(iw/2\)\*2:ceil\(ih/2\)\*2:color=black -c:v libx264 -threads 2 -preset veryfast -crf 20 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart /home/hong/camrod_ws/src/docs/evidence/virtual_carla/site_completion_20261012_v5/B5/visual/carla_camrod_desktop.mp4
# capture_duration_policy allow_short_capture=true requested_duration_s=1800 actual_duration_s=386.400000 tolerance_s=1.000000 early_finalized=true

(cd /home/hong/camrod_ws/src/docs/evidence/virtual_carla/site_completion_20261012_v5/B5/visual && sha256sum representative_contact_sheet.png representative_motion.gif ffprobe.json exact_commands.txt capture_manifest.json > sha256sums.txt)
sha256sums_scope: retained files only; when source_video.retained is false, its pre-removal provenance is recorded under recording.source_video
acceptance_limit: Visual evidence alone does not prove CARLA actor identity, sensor-source ownership, physical wheel telemetry, safety-gate state, mission success, or that no third-party X11 window occluded part of the recorded region.
